name: Coronation Infrastructure Fund
source: CRON 20261014: Coronation Infrastructure Fund statement of comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), CIF column, thousands of naira scaled to naira. Interest income plus other income less operating expenses equals the printed operating profit, which is the whole of the period result: the fund charged no tax and reports total comprehensive income equal to it. The filing prints a single period column with no comparative. | Coronation Infrastructure Fund 2025 Annual Report, audited Statement of Comprehensive Income, filed with the Nigerian Exchange
